theme_cn: 模板写作 + KET/PET题型 + 语法复习 + 听力 + 键盘拼写
listening_name: 听力：听对话 + 选图 + 听写

writing.title: The Dragon Boat Festival in My Hometown
writing.template: The Dragon Boat Festival is very important {{1}}. On that morning, my grandmother and I make {{2}} with sweet rice and red beans. In the afternoon, we go to the river to watch {{3}}. My father tells me the story of the old poet, and we eat zongzi to {{4}}. Every year we cook more than we need, and we {{5}} so that everyone can taste them.
writing.full_text_cn: 端午节在我的家乡非常重要。那天早上，我和奶奶用糯米和红豆包粽子。下午我们去河边看龙舟比赛。爸爸给我讲那位老诗人的故事，我们吃粽子来纪念屈原。每年我们都会多做一些，然后和邻居分享，让每个人都能尝到。
writing.explanation_cn: 这篇写作介绍家乡的端午节，五个关键词分别落在五处：1) in my hometown 在我的家乡；2) rice dumplings 粽子；3) dragon boat races 龙舟比赛；4) remember Qu Yuan 纪念屈原；5) share with neighbours 和邻居分享。全文用一般现在时描述每年的固定做法，主语 we / my family 用动词原形。注意 make zongzi with…（用……包粽子）和 so that（以便）两个句型。
writing.explanation_en: This piece introduces a hometown festival with five key phrases. Use the simple present for yearly habits. Notice the patterns 'make something with something' and 'so that' for purpose.

ket_pet.question: KET: I'd like ___ ticket to Beijing, please.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: ticket 是可数名词单数，泛指「一张」用 a。

ket_pet.question: KET: ___ is the ticket? — Twenty yuan.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 问价格用 How much；How many 问可数数量。

ket_pet.question: PET: This is the station ___ we met last year.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 先行词是地点 station，从句 we met 不缺宾语，缺地点状语，用 where。

ket_pet.question: PET: The train was so crowded that we ___ stand all the way.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: so...that 从句描述过去的情况，用 had to（不得不）表示过去的必须。

ket_pet.question: PET: She asked me ___ I had finished the project.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 宾语从句原本是一般疑问句，转述时用 whether/if 引导。

grammar.question: My family has lived in this town ___ 2019.
grammar.explanation_cn: since + 时间点（2019），for + 一段时间（five years）。

grammar.question: There ___ some milk in the fridge for breakfast.
grammar.explanation_cn: There be 就近原则：milk 不可数，用 is。

grammar.question: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home and read.
grammar.explanation_cn: if 条件句主将从现：主句 will + 动词原形，从句用一般现在时。

grammar.question: Linda is the ___ girl in our class.
grammar.explanation_cn: in our class 是范围，用最高级；tall 是单音节词加 est。

grammar.question: I ___ my homework when my mother came home.
grammar.explanation_cn: 过去某个时刻正在做某事，用过去进行时 was doing。

grammar.question: ___ you like to come to my birthday party?
grammar.explanation_cn: Would you like to do sth. 是礼貌邀请的固定句式。

grammar.question: The book ___ by many students in our school.
grammar.explanation_cn: 书是「被读」的，用被动语态 be + 过去分词。

listening.question: 听对话，人们吃粽子是为了什么？
listening.audio_text: Girl: Dad, why do we eat zongzi at the Dragon Boat Festival? Dad: Because we want to remember the poet Qu Yuan. Girl: And what are those long boats for? Dad: They are for the dragon boat races.
listening.explanation_cn: 爸爸说 Because we want to remember the poet Qu Yuan（为了纪念诗人屈原）。后半段说的是龙舟，不是粽子的用意。

listening.question: 听对话，奶奶什么时候学会包粽子的？
listening.audio_text: Boy: Can you make zongzi, Grandma? Grandma: Yes, I learned it from my mother when I was ten. Boy: It looks difficult. Grandma: It is easy once you try.
listening.explanation_cn: 奶奶说 I learned it from my mother when I was ten（十岁时跟妈妈学的）。

listening.question: 听到的句子说的是哪幅图？
listening.audio_text: We watched the dragon boat race on the river yesterday.
listening.explanation_cn: 句子里说的是 dragon boat race（龙舟比赛），船在河上，所以选 🛶。

listening.question: 听录音填空：Every year we cook more zongzi than we need and share them with our ___.
listening.audio_text: Every year we cook more zongzi than we need and share them with our friends.
listening.explanation_cn: 听到的是 share them with our friends（和朋友们分享），friends 是复数。

spell.question: 粽子：d________ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: dumpling 中间是 mpl，读 /ˈdʌmplɪŋ/；rice dumpling 就是粽子。

spell.question: 节日：f_______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: festival 重音在第一个音节，读 /ˈfestɪvl/。

spell.question: 比赛：r___ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: race 读 /reɪs/，dragon boat race 就是龙舟比赛。

spell.question: 分享：s____ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: share sth. with sb. 和某人分享某物，读 /ʃeə/。
